hooks.command: cmd=$(jq -r '.tool_input.command // ""'); if echo "$cmd" | grep -qE '(^|[[:space:]])(git[[:space:]]+push|gh[[:space:]])'; then active=$(gh auth status 2>&1 | awk '/Logged in.*account/ {acc=$(NF-1)} /Active account: true/ {print acc; exit}'); if [ "$active" != "prasoon-pradeep" ]; then printf '{"decision":"block","reason":"Wrong GitHub account active (%s). Run: gh auth switch --user prasoon-pradeep"}\n' "$active"; fi; fi
